mechanics.name: Beam me up
mechanics.summary: Cast the spell from your graveyard by paying the alternate cost and returning your creature. Reuse that creature’s enters ability on a later turn.

mechanics.name: Face a dilemma
mechanics.summary: Choosing one or more modes on a spell or ability counts once. A payoff can trigger even if that spell is countered.

mechanics.name: Federation
mechanics.summary: Diversify creature types among your non-Borg creatures to increase federation bonuses.

mechanics.name: Strange new worlds
mechanics.summary: The payoff counts distinct land names. Duplicate lands of the same name contribute only once.

mechanics.name: Spacecraft and station
mechanics.summary: Tap creatures at sorcery speed to add charge counters equal to their power. Station thresholds unlock the spacecraft’s stronger abilities.

mechanics.name: Assimilate
mechanics.summary: Assimilation gives you the card as a Borg artifact creature with a +1/+1 counter. Artifact-creature bonuses apply.

archetypes.name: Spacecraft and Artificers
archetypes.playstyle: Use creatures with enters effects as station crew. Keep the board stable until your spacecraft can attack.

archetypes.name: Borg Artifact Creatures
archetypes.playstyle: Establish artifact creatures, then turn a wide board into pressure with an anthem. Spare artifacts can fuel sacrifice effects.

archetypes.name: Command 8+ Power
archetypes.playstyle: Fill the board with Officers and reach eight total power before attacking. Preserve enough bodies to keep that threshold on later turns.

archetypes.name: Doctors and Counters
archetypes.playstyle: Spread counters across your creatures so Phlox pays you for attacks and The Doctor can grow several creatures at once.

archetypes.name: Dilemma Control
archetypes.playstyle: Hold up flexible interaction, then take over with repeated dilemma triggers. Prioritize cards with useful modes on both offense and defense.

archetypes.name: Scientists and Noncreatures
archetypes.playstyle: Pair cheap noncreature spells with token-copy payoffs. Give Gray and Adira a valuable creature to copy before casting your setup spell.

archetypes.name: Strange New Worlds
archetypes.playstyle: Draft differently named lands to grow your payoffs. Favor lands that still let you cast your early green and blue spells on time.

archetypes.name: Klingons and Dies
archetypes.playstyle: Attack with temporary tokens, then sacrifice them for value before they leave anyway. Include creatures that replace themselves when they die.

archetypes.name: Archaeology Graveyard
archetypes.playstyle: Stock the graveyard, then recur cards or cast them from there to trigger Vash. Prefer cheap effects that set up later turns.

archetypes.name: Away Team Landfall
archetypes.playstyle: Keep making land drops and use landfall rewards to build a board. Save repeatable land triggers for turns when you can capitalize on them.

combos.note: Choosing a mode for Lore’s enters trigger faces a dilemma and draws a card with Seven of Nine in play.
Casting Preservation with beam me up takes it out of your graveyard and triggers Vash if her ability hasn’t triggered this turn. Return a different creature to keep Vash on the battlefield.
